data: What is the approximate value of the blue line in the top right graph at polarity 0.5?

The question asks for the approximate value of the blue line in the top right graph at polarity 0.5. The blue line represents the positive class. From the figure, we can see that the blue line peaks around the middle of the graph, which corresponds to a polarity of approximately 0.5. At this point, the blue line appears to be around 1.0 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line at polarity 0.5 is 1.0.
